Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_PROTECTOR_ST
Description: Defines armor reinforcement. An armor piece uses the row Reinforce Type ID + the last two digits of its ID, and its defences and resistances are multiplied by that row's rates. Armor can't be upgraded in Elden Ring: every retail armor uses row 0, whose rates are all 1. Keep that row: without a reinforce row, armor still gives its defences but no status resistance.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's physical defence. The armor's own strike, slash and pierce bonuses still apply on top.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's magic defence.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's fire defence.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's lightning defence. The game also uses it for the armor's holy defence (Defence %: Holy is not read).

Fields.Name: Defence %: Slash
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the armor's slash bonus isn't scaled by the reinforce row. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Strike
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the armor's strike bonus isn't scaled by the reinforce row. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Thrust
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the armor's pierce bonus isn't scaled by the reinforce row. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Poison
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's poison resistance.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's scarlet rot resistance.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's blood loss resistance.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's death blight resistance.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the armor's Resident SpEffect ID [1]. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the armor's Resident SpEffect ID [2]. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the armor's Resident SpEffect ID [3]. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Material Set Offset
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: armor can't be reinforced in Elden Ring.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Holy
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: holy defence is multiplied by Defence %: Lightning instead. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's frostbite resistance. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Sleep
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's sleep resistance. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Madness
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's madness resistance. Retail: always 1.
